recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-10128; any renewed IID example or vocabulary work should be coordinated with the IHE Endpoint profiles/vocabulary rather than reintroducing retired core IHE connection-type content.
issue_request: FHIR-10128 was Published/Persuasive for the Patient Administration Endpoint resource. It requested Endpoint support for diagnostic-imaging services including DICOM WADO-URI, DICOM WADO-RS, and IHE IID, with payload type/format optional where headers, query parameters, or protocol behavior determine the payload.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-10128 or GF#10128 was found. Nearby Endpoint history shows 3e7c097ade adding ihe-iid, dicom-wado-rs, dicom-qido-rs, dicom-stow-rs, and dicom-wado-uri connection-type content and imaging example rows, followed by d6c6d61a72 adding IID and WADO-RS Endpoint examples and migrating imaging examples toward Endpoint references. This aligns with the Jira comments saying the changes had already been made and the submitter confirmed they looked good.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. The current StructureDefinition has repeatable CodeableConcept connectionType with an example binding and optional Endpoint.payload type/mimeType elements, so negotiated or externally defined payload details are representable. Current Endpoint and ImagingSelection source covers DICOM WADO-RS, WADO-URI, QIDO-RS, and STOW-RS. Later FHIR-36589 changed connectionType to CodeableConcept, relaxed the binding, and moved IHE values to IHE-defined profiles/vocabulary; the current Endpoint notes point readers to IHE mCSD, and the legacy IID example remains inactive after terminology build fixes.
reconciliation: No FHIR core source change was made. The current core source already reflects the DICOM Endpoint support requested by FHIR-10128, and the IHE IID portion is now governed outside core by later published Endpoint terminology decisions.
